notes: Every individual JSON file contains a role/content message array directly usable as pipe(messages).
The master JSON contains test_case_id, source_file, and messages for each source case.
Policy text is the first line of the first user message.

Names, usernames, global roles, effective course roles, courses, group memberships, task requests, operations, target resources, target owners, and policy text are checked against the original Markdown source.
A compact subset of relevant LMS page state is included where unambiguous (quiz attempt/window metadata, a single due timestamp, or targeted grading status).
Prior access-denied/403 page results are not inserted into the conversations because they would leak the authorization outcome being evaluated.
No expected PASS/FAIL labels are included in the model input.
